"""Tiny saved-document identity diagnostic; run from the repository root."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile

REPO = Path.cwd().resolve()
RESULT = REPO / "scripts/bench/cadgen-performance/results/material-document-identity-20260910.json"
COMMON = REPO / "scripts/bench/cadgen-performance/common.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("cadgen_benchmark_common", COMMON)
common = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(common)
metadata = common.metadata()
paths = (
    "packages/cadgen/src/cadgen/store/build.py",
    "packages/cadgen/src/cadgen/store/materialize.py",
    "packages/cadgen/src/cadgen/store/records.py",
    "packages/cadgen/src/cadgen/_internal/component_package.py",
    "packages/cadgen/src/cadgen/_internal/source_sidecar.py",
    "packages/cadgen/src/cadgen/_internal/step_scene_loader.py",
    "packages/cadgen/src/cadgen/_internal/step_scene_mesh.py",
    "packages/cadgen/src/cadgen/step_export.py",
)
metadata["implementationFiles"] = {
    path: hashlib.sha256((REPO / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in paths
}
metadata["purpose"] = "Functional correctness diagnostic, not a performance measurement"
original_cache = os.environ.get("CADGEN_CACHE_DIR")
scratch_base = REPO / "models/tmp"
scratch_base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
runs = []
step_payloads = []
try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="material-document-identity-", dir=scratch_base) as tmp:
        scratch = Path(tmp)
        os.environ["CADGEN_CACHE_DIR"] = str(scratch / "generated-store")
        from build123d import Color, Solid
        from cadgen.store.build import build_tree_from_compound, build_tree_through_step
        from cadgen.store.records import note_document_tree, tree_for_document_hash
        from cadgen._internal.step_scene_loader import load_step_scene
        from cadgen._internal.step_scene_mesh import scene_to_build123d_compound

        output = scratch / "box.step"
        for material in ({"roughness": .1, "metalness": .2}, {"roughness": .9, "metalness": .8}):
            shape = Solid.make_box(2, 3, 4)
            shape.label = "box"
            shape.color = Color(.8, .7, .6, 1)
            shape.cad_material = material
            previews = []
            tree_hash, tree, _stats, document_hash = build_tree_through_step(
                shape, output, root_name="box", on_preview=lambda digest, value: previews.append((digest, value))
            )
            payload = output.read_bytes()
            assert hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() == document_hash
            step_payloads.append(payload)
            note_document_tree(document_hash, tree_hash)
            runs.append({
                "authoredMaterial": material, "stepBytes": len(payload), "stepHash": document_hash,
                "treeHash": tree_hash, "tree": tree,
                "previewTreeHash": previews[0][0], "previewTree": previews[0][1],
                "indexedTreeAfterPublication": tree_for_document_hash(document_hash),
                "sidecarExists": output.with_name(output.name + ".json").exists(),
            })
        shared_document_hash = runs[0]["stepHash"]
        indexed_tree_after_both = tree_for_document_hash(shared_document_hash)
        os.environ["CADGEN_CACHE_DIR"] = str(scratch / "cold-import-store")
        assert tree_for_document_hash(shared_document_hash) is None
        scene = load_step_scene(output, record_read=False)
        imported = scene_to_build123d_compound(scene)
        cold_hash, cold_tree, _ = build_tree_from_compound(imported, root_name="box")
        note_document_tree(shared_document_hash, cold_hash)
        cold = {
            "method": "Raw text STEP load into an empty store; scene_to_build123d_compound then build_tree_from_compound (same imported-scene packaging path). No Python author source, model record or generated tree consulted.",
            "treeHash": cold_hash, "tree": cold_tree,
            "indexedTreeAfterPublication": tree_for_document_hash(shared_document_hash),
            "materialPresent": any("material" in occ for occ in cold_tree.get("occurrences", [])),
        }
finally:
    if original_cache is None:
        os.environ.pop("CADGEN_CACHE_DIR", None)
    else:
        os.environ["CADGEN_CACHE_DIR"] = original_cache

changed_fields = sorted(key for key in set(runs[0]["tree"]) | set(runs[1]["tree"])
                        if runs[0]["tree"].get(key) != runs[1]["tree"].get(key))
result = {
    "metadata": metadata,
    "probeSource": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
    "fixtureSource": "shape = Solid.make_box(2, 3, 4)\nshape.label = 'box'\nshape.color = Color(.8, .7, .6, 1)\nshape.cad_material = material\nbuild_tree_through_step(shape, output, root_name='box', on_preview=callback)\n",
    "command": "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=packages/cadgen/src /Users/jakefitzgerald/robots/text-to-cad/.venv/bin/python tmp/material-document-identity-probe.py",
    "reproduction": "From the repository root, write this JSON's probeSource string to tmp/material-document-identity-probe.py and execute command. All CAD outputs and both isolated stores are temporary directories under models/tmp and are cleaned in finally/context exit.",
    "runs": runs, "coldImport": cold,
    "comparison": {
        "exactStepBytesEqual": step_payloads[0] == step_payloads[1],
        "stepSha256Equal": runs[0]["stepHash"] == runs[1]["stepHash"],
        "generatedSavedTreesEqual": runs[0]["treeHash"] == runs[1]["treeHash"],
        "generatedSavedTreeChangedTopLevelFields": changed_fields,
        "generatedSavedComponentsEqual": runs[0]["tree"]["components"] == runs[1]["tree"]["components"],
        "previewTreesEqual": runs[0]["previewTreeHash"] == runs[1]["previewTreeHash"],
        "sameDocumentIndexAfterBothPublications": indexed_tree_after_both,
        "coldImportEqualsGeneratedA": cold_hash == runs[0]["treeHash"],
        "coldImportEqualsGeneratedB": cold_hash == runs[1]["treeHash"],
    },
    "limitations": [
        "A direct low-level generated STEP publication probe, not a full decorator/daemon integration test.",
        "Only roughness and metalness vary; opacity/clearcoat fields are source-inspected but not individually probed.",
        "Cold-import tree may differ in additional metadata; the generated A/B comparison isolates occurrence.material exactly.",
        "No product source was edited for this diagnostic; no large assembly, browser or timed benchmark ran.",
    ],
    "runtimeUnchangedDuringProbe": common.source_fingerprint() == metadata["sourceFingerprint"],
}
common.write_json(RESULT, result)
print(json.dumps({"result": str(RESULT), "comparison": result["comparison"],
                  "coldImport": {key: value for key, value in cold.items() if key != "tree"},
                  "runs": [{key: run[key] for key in ("stepBytes", "stepHash", "treeHash", "previewTreeHash")} for run in runs]}, indent=2))
